attributes.board_name: Arkansas Board of Examiners in Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology (ABESPA)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Live presentations, webinars, workshops, college courses (1 credit hour = 15 clock hours), online activities with documentation, self-study (ABESPA self-study report required; replays of live conferences count as self-study), CPE offered by national SLP/audiology organizations. Board may pre-approve programs.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Provisional and full licensees are not required to report CPE and are not audited in the initial licensing year.
rules.audit_note: Annual random audit; late audit documentation costs $50 per month; failure to comply leads to disciplinary action.
rules.legal_basis: Ark. Code Ann. § 17-100-306; ABESPA Rules (Agency 117.00) Section 9
rules.notes: Annual license. At least 5 of the 10 hours in Content Area I (core SLP/audiology science and clinical practice); the rest may be Content Area II (regulations, service delivery, ethics, supervision, reimbursement, etc.). Dual licensees: 15 clock hours, at least 5 per discipline from Content Area I. CE is entered in CE Broker before renewal. Renewal date is inconsistent in official sources: the rule (eff. Apr 1, 2024) and the 2026 paper form say licenses expire June 30; the board's renewal page says licenses expire Oct 31 (CPE period Nov 1–Oct 31). Check with the board.

rules.accepted_credit_types: Activities within the SLPA scope of responsibilities; at least 5 hours in Content Area I for Assistants (normal development, treatment strategies, evaluation techniques, reading/writing as related to communication, disorder types).
rules.notes: 1 hour for every month of registration, maximum 10 hours per fiscal year. Arkansas registers SLP assistants under ABESPA.
